title: command palette: navigation entries match on scattered letters, so "zzzz" returns Field Zoo and "ingest" returns Cascading Select
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: ⌘K command palette in the showcase app: query `zzzz` returns *Field Zoo* and *New Project (Wizard)*; `ingest` returns *In-Progress Tasks*, *Cascading Select*, *Page Authoring*, *Styling (ADR-0065)* besides the real hit; `wayne` returns *Styling (ADR-0065)* next to Wayne Enterprises.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Record results are accurate (`华宁` → the account and three contacts; `wayne` → Wayne Enterprises). The Objects and Pages groups, though, match letters scattered across the whole label, so nonsense queries never reach "No results" and real queries pull in unrelated entries. Opening the palette also appends `?palette=1` to the page URL.

## Expected

Navigation entries match on word prefixes or contiguous substrings (with a small typo tolerance at most); a query that matches nothing shows "No results".

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Replace the subsequence matcher for nav entries with prefix/substring scoring and a minimum score; keep fuzzy matching for records server-side.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *command palette fuzzy search loose matching nav entries no results*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *cmdk search matches unrelated pages by subsequence letters, typing gibberish still shows navigation results*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#3047 (closed) — same command-palette navigation search; truncation of the nav scope, not over-loose matching
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#7393 (closed) — same command palette surface; request duplication, different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
